conclusion: Verified: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the high-level requirement for transparent, orthogonal EV characterization, separation from non‑vesicular particles, production reporting, and fit‑for‑purpose assays prior to advancing formulation or cross‑species bridging. Not verified / unsupported: program‑specific assertions that SGL‑001 already meets those requirements (existence/characterization of an MCB/WCB, a defined orthogonal QC panel with SOPs, validated intact‑EV release assays with LLOQ/specificity/precision/accuracy, a stability‑indicating mechanism‑linked potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint, three GMP‑like reproducible batches with release/stability/potency comparability, and formulation/device compatibility data demonstrating intact‑EV recovery).
unsupported_assertions: Existence and characterization of an SGL‑001 MCB/WCB (program‑specific MCB/WCB documents)
Defined orthogonal QC panel and SOPs for SGL‑001 (particle counts, protein/lipid/marker panels, non‑vesicular particle controls)
Validated intact‑EV release assays for SGL‑001 with demonstrated LLOQ, specificity, precision, and accuracy
A stability‑indicating, mechanism‑linked potency assay for SGL‑001 correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint
Three GMP‑like batch production records showing reproducible release, stability, and potency across lots
Ex vivo/in vivo formulation‑device compatibility data demonstrating intact‑EV recovery with appropriate orthogonal controls
